title: Structural Pass Analysis in Football: Learning Pass Archetypes and Tactical Impact from Spatio-Temporal Tracking Data
abstract: arXiv:2603.28916v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Passing actions are commonly evaluated through ball progression and attacking outcomes, yet their relationship with the spatial organisation of the opposition provides an additional perspective on passing behaviour. This study introduces an interpretable framework for describing passing structure using synchronised event and tracking data. Three complementary descriptors are proposed: Line Bypass Score (LBS), measuring the difference in goal-side opponent counts between passer and receiver; Space Gain Metric (SGM), comparing their nearest-opponent distances; and Structural Disruption Index (SDI), summarising differences in defensive organisation between pass initiation and a sampled state one second later. Following transformation and standardisation, these descriptors are combined into Tactical Impact Value (TIV), a fixed-weight structural composite. translated_title: 足球传球结构分析：从时空追踪数据中学习传球原型与战术影响
translated_abstract: 传球动作通常通过球权推进和进攻结果来评估，然而传球与对方空间组织之间的关系为传球行为提供了另一个观察视角。本研究引入了一个可解释的框架，利用同步的事件数据和追踪数据来描述传球结构。该框架提出三个互补的描述指标：线突破得分（LBS），衡量传球者与接球者之间球门侧防守人数的差异；空间增益度量（SGM），比较二者与最近防守球员的距离；以及结构破坏指数（SDI），概括传球发起时与一秒后采样时刻防守组织的差异。经过转换与标准化处理后，这些指标被组合成战术影响值（TIV），一个固定权重的结构性综合指标。该框架应用于2022年卡塔尔世界杯的41,078个运动战传球事件……
tldr: 该论文提出了由线突破得分（LBS）、空间增益度量（SGM）和结构破坏指数（SDI）组合而成的可解释战术影响值（TIV）框架，利用时空追踪数据量化足球传球对对方防守结构的突破与破坏效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an interpretable Tactical Impact Value (TIV) framework, combining Line Bypass Score, Space Gain Metric, and Structural Disruption Index, to quantify how football passes bypass and disrupt opposing defensive structures using spatio-temporal tracking data.
